scope: Fixed 131072-row SQL ReplicatedApply including final fold; three durable collections, no RF3/network/admission. Shared host; other applications are not stopped.

metric_notes.device-bytes: User relation device bytes, not total device bytes across all three collections; system-device-bytes is recorded separately.
metric_notes.final-allocated-file-B: Final allocated bytes across all collection files.
metric_notes.append-leaf-splits: Counts physical structural split transactions, not every logical volatile tail split.
metric_notes.tail-split-current-charge: Lineage metadata and retained router-history charge.
metric_notes.tail-split-peak-charge: Includes dirty frame arena and in-flight frame, router, planning scratch and fold reservations; not RSS.

pair_order: For each workload: main/candidate, candidate/main, main/candidate.
